generator.params.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 286-287), Stangeria eriopus: stem subterranean, subglobose to tuberous, to 10 cm across; leaves one to three, 0.3 to 2 m long, about half of it petiole; leaflets in 5 to 20 pairs; 5 years from seed to cone in cultivation. Drawn as a trunk 0.05 m in radius, staying underground; fronds 0.9 m long, the petiole 0.5 of them, 12 pairs of leaflets, the longest leaflet 0.22 of the frond; 0.8 fronds a year, as the crown's count over the three years a frond lives (estimated); first cones at 5 years (estimated, as the research note's timing table records). Female cone solitary on a peduncle 2.8 to 4 cm, male cone on one about 6 cm.

appearance.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 286-287), Stangeria eriopus: its leaflets drawn as wide, for their length, as the median leaflets it gives; the rest of its look from its order and family.

allometry.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 286-287), Stangeria eriopus: stem subterranean, subglobose to tuberous, to 10 cm across; leaves one to three, 0.3 to 2 m long, about half of it petiole; leaflets in 5 to 20 pairs; 5 years from seed to cone in cultivation. The whole plant's height at 30 years estimated from these, its stem (or none, where it stays underground) under a crown of young leaves standing about 0.85 of a leaf above it: about 0.8 m. Whitelock gives no ages, so the tolerance is wide.

traits.cone_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 286-287), Stangeria eriopus: female cone ellipsoid to ovoid, to 18 cm long, blunt.

traits.cone_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 286-287), Stangeria eriopus: female cone to 8 cm across.

traits.cone_face_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 286), Stangeria eriopus: the megasporophyll's face about 4 by 6 cm, smooth, convex and overlapping, in up to six vertical columns.

traits.cone_shape.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 286-287), Stangeria eriopus: female cone ellipsoid to ovoid.

traits.cone_apex.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 286-287), Stangeria eriopus: female cone blunt.

traits.cone_colour.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 286-287), Stangeria eriopus: female cone velvety white to tan, glabrous with age; the colour by eye.

traits.pollen_cone_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 286-287), Stangeria eriopus: male cone subcylindrical, tapering, 10 to 25 cm long.

traits.pollen_cone_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 286-287), Stangeria eriopus: male cone 3 to 4 cm across.

traits.pollen_cone_face_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 286), Stangeria eriopus: microsporophylls about 1.2 cm long, rhomboid, the face 0.4 to 0.6 by 1.2 cm.

traits.pollen_cone_shape.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 286-287), Stangeria eriopus: male cone subcylindrical, tapering.

traits.pollen_cone_colour.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 286-287), Stangeria eriopus: male cone silvery-white velvet when young, glabrous yellow-brown later; the shedding colour by eye.

traits.seed_length_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 286-287), Stangeria eriopus: sarcotesta ovoid, to 3.5 cm long.

traits.seed_width_m.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 286-287), Stangeria eriopus: sarcotesta to 2.5 cm across.

traits.seed_colour_ripe.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 286-287), Stangeria eriopus: sarcotesta dark red when ripe; the colour by eye.

traits.sexual_system.note: Whitelock (2002, p. 286-287), Stangeria eriopus: male and female cones on separate plants, as in every cycad (p. 19).
